scenes.narration: Choose how you want to install spaCR. Use a desktop installer for a ready-to-launch application, pip for a Python virtual environment, or conda-forge for a Conda environment. Start from the official spaCR links shown here.
scenes.speech_text: Choose how you want to install spacer. Use a desktop installer for a ready-to-launch application, pip for a Python virtual environment, or Conda Forge for a Conda environment. Start from the official spacer links shown here.

scenes.narration: On PyPI, find spaCR and read the installation command beside the current release. Copy that command when you are ready to install into your Python environment. The pip tutorial shows how to create and activate that environment first.
scenes.speech_text: On [pie pee eye](/pˌI pˌi ˈI/), find spacer and read the installation command beside the current release. Copy that command when you are ready to install into your Python environment. The pip tutorial shows how to create and activate that environment first.

scenes.narration: Use Project links to open the documentation, source repository or issue tracker. Bookmark the documentation so you can return to the module walkthroughs while working in spaCR.
scenes.speech_text: Use Project links to open the documentation, source repository or issue tracker. Bookmark the documentation so you can return to the module walkthroughs while working in spacer.

scenes.narration: On GitHub, open the spaCR repository. Main contains the release source, and nightly contains the latest development work. For a packaged desktop installation, open Releases and choose a release.
scenes.speech_text: On [GitHub](/ɡˈɪthˌʌb/), open the spacer repository. Main contains the release source, and nightly contains the latest development work. For a packaged desktop installation, open Releases and choose a release.

scenes.narration: Expand Assets and download the installer for Windows, macOS or Linux. The Platform installers lesson explains installation, launching spaCR and uninstalling it on each operating system.
scenes.speech_text: Expand Assets and download the installer for Windows, [macOS](/mˈækOˌɛs/) or Linux. The Platform installers lesson explains installation, launching spacer and uninstalling it on each operating system.

scenes.narration: On conda-forge, open the spaCR package page and check the available version. Package channels can update at different times, so select the version available through the route you choose.
scenes.speech_text: On Conda Forge, open the spacer package page and check the available version. Package channels can update at different times, so select the version available through the route you choose.

scenes.narration: The conda-forge command installs spaCR into your active Conda environment. Follow Install spaCR to create that environment, install the package and launch the application. That lesson also explains package and environment removal.
scenes.speech_text: The Conda Forge command installs spacer into your active Conda environment. Follow Install spacer to create that environment, install the package and launch the application. That lesson also explains package and environment removal.

scenes.narration: Continue with Install spaCR for pip or conda-forge, or Platform installers for a desktop installer. Both lessons include uninstall guidance. Once spaCR opens, move to Home, then the pipeline overviews to choose a workflow for your data.
scenes.speech_text: Continue with Install spacer for pip or Conda Forge, or Platform installers for a desktop installer. Both lessons include uninstall guidance. Once spacer opens, move to Home, then the pipeline overviews to choose a workflow for your data.
